title: Smart Bin telemetry
description: Message a bin publishes to bins/<bin_id>/telemetry. This schema is the source of truth: firmware, backend and simulator must all match it.

bin_id.description: Unique bin identifier, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (e.g. bin-014). Must match the <bin_id> in the topic.

state.description: idle = waiting, compacting = crush cycle in progress, full = contents can no longer be compressed and the bin needs emptying.

compactions_since_empty.description: Number of compaction cycles completed since the bin was last emptied. Resets to 0 when emptied.

weight.description: Current contents weight in kilograms (1 decimal place is plenty).
